name: Stripe
description: 把支付调查、订阅与账单、对账和高风险操作审查组合成安全的 Stripe 工作流。

composer.prompt: 使用 Stripe 插件先核对测试/生产环境、对象和金额，再调查支付、订阅、账单或执行经确认的操作。

en.description: Combine payment investigation, subscriptions and billing, reconciliation, and high-risk operation review into safe Stripe workflows.

composer.prompt: Use the Stripe plugin to verify the test or production environment, object, and amount before investigating payments, subscriptions, invoices, or performing confirmed operations.

stripe-mcp.label: Official Stripe Remote MCP
stripe-mcp.description: Access the user's authorized Stripe account and tools through persistent OAuth.

stripe-payment-investigation.label: Payment Investigation
stripe-payment-investigation.description: Investigate payment issues using PaymentIntent, Charge, refund, and event evidence.

stripe-billing-subscriptions.label: Subscriptions & Billing
stripe-billing-subscriptions.description: Verify customers, subscriptions, invoices, prices, and lifecycle status.

stripe-reconciliation.label: Payment Reconciliation
stripe-reconciliation.description: Reconcile Stripe objects with business records by currency and time range.

stripe-safe-operations.label: Safe Operations
stripe-safe-operations.description: Confirm the object, amount, and environment before refunds, cancellations, or other high-risk writes.

network.reason: Connect to the official Stripe remote MCP and access payment and billing data authorized through OAuth.

workspace-read.reason: Read user-selected order or reconciliation materials from the current workspace.

permissions.reason: 连接 Stripe 官方远程 MCP，并访问用户通过 OAuth 授权的支付和账单数据。
读取当前工作区中用户指定的订单或对账资料。

resources.label: Stripe 官方远程 MCP
resources.description: 通过持久化 OAuth 访问用户授权的 Stripe 账户和工具。

resources.label: 支付调查
resources.description: 从 PaymentIntent、Charge、退款和事件证据调查支付问题。

resources.label: 订阅与账单
resources.description: 核对客户、订阅、Invoice、价格和生命周期状态。

resources.label: 支付对账
resources.description: 按币种和时间范围核对 Stripe 对象与业务记录。

resources.label: 安全操作
resources.description: 在退款、取消和其他高风险写入前进行对象、金额与环境确认。
